doc.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Personnel of the 1939 Miller band
summary: Best lists the trumpets, reeds, drummer and bassists in the 1939 band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well the Swing Era, I wanted to back track just a minute. When you joined Glenn Miller in ‘39, can you recall who else was in that band at that time?
McMickle, Clyde Hurley and Lee Knowles. Lee was the head of Bulio Vineyards, a fine wine place. He died about, within the last year.
No kidding. And was Tex Benecke?
Tex was in the band. Al Klink, Willie Schwartz, Hal McIntyre. The drummer was Maurice Purtill, the bass player was Rolly Bundock. He was replaced by Trigger Alpert. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
Who was replaced by Goldberg. Some of those guys were drafted, that’s why they were replaced.
